name: scrapyard
description: Scrapyard — a BlazeRush-themed neon leaderboard for the crew.
//: ONE manifest for the whole repo. There is no `workspaces` key and no
per-app package.json — apps/* and packages/* are plain folders with their
own tsconfig, resolved through the `paths` mapping in tsconfig.base.json.
The dependencies / devDependencies split is doing real work here, and is
dependencies    = required by `node apps/api/dist/main.js` at runtime.
devDependencies = everything else. That INCLUDES react, react-router and
lucide-react, because Vite bundles them into the client
asset at build time — Node never requires them.
So `npm ci --omit=dev` installs exactly the API's runtime closure, which is
what the Docker image ships. Front-end tree-shaking is Rollup's job and is
already automatic; this split is the server-side equivalent.
ts-node, not tsx/esbuild: Nest's DI reads constructor parameter types from
`emitDecoratorMetadata` output, which esbuild cannot produce. tsx fails at
transform time on the parameter decorators and would fail at runtime on DI.

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
